evals.prompt: I want to set up a wiki to organize my work — meetings, decisions, and the people I manage. Can you help me create one?
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Begins a plain-language interview about how the user works, matches them to an archetype, proposes a personalized OKF structure, and only scaffolds after confirmation. Generates a bespoke /<wiki-name> operating skill.

evals.prompt: Build me a personal knowledge base / second brain for my projects and my 1:1s.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Interviews, proposes a structure with people/ (profiles + per-topic conversations) and projects/ (with optional sub-projects), scaffolds the vault + the operating skill, and wires qmd search if available.

evals.prompt: I keep losing track of what we decide in founder meetings. I want a system that captures meetings and pulls out the action items and decisions automatically.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Designs a wiki whose meeting flow fans out into actionables/decisions (and patterns/results), each backlinking to the meeting and participants. Generates an operating skill with a `meeting` operation.
